summary: @servicetitan/help-center preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: The package declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs` that fetches the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<V>/...zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmod +x's the binary, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle with hex-mangled `_0xNNNN` identifiers and a rotated string-array cipher (`push(shift())` rotation), with no readable code paths. The package is published under a scope resembling a well-known field-service-management vendor and is advertised as a React help-center UI component library; a UI component library has no legitimate reason to download a language runtime and use it to execute an opaque bundled payload during `npm install`. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: an alien runtime is fetched at install time specifically so that Node-based scanners cannot introspect the executed bytecode, and the payload runs automatically on `npm install` with the installer's user privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
